modes.DIRECTIONAL: constant scalar times root-oriented cosine bands
modes.ROLE_CURVATURE: same bands times pooled role and actual geometry gains

coherent_rules.planarity: max four cyclic fourth-plane distances / perimeter of the other three vertices
coherent_rules.bending: mean over four adjacent faces of 1 - clipped dot of actual unit face normals
coherent_rules.coherence_scope: flat regular-scale constant-field approximation; not exact for curved/nonuniform regions
coherent_rules.coefficient_scope: new dimensionless normal coefficients times current local incident mean-edge scales
coherent_rules.symmetry_scope: canonical inherited face signs applied to actual XYZ; no XYZ averaging

support_policy.face: G03 actual face_event_ids > 0 transported by actual G04 parent_face
support_policy.edge_vertex: incident G04 face means; signed scalar pooled before normal coefficients
support_policy.boundary: final face scalar is multiplied by face support; coupled XYZ halo is allowed

topology_scope: Same ordered CC connectivity in all three new conditions and frozen COMBINED baseline; intersections allowed, no repair.
visual_scope: Matched original renders; actual fine folds and hierarchy assessed separately from numerical PASS.
